by
  intro Ω ι _ P _ X s t hX hI hE
  exact hI.mgf_sum hX s
target_source: ∀ (Ω ι : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (t : ℝ), (∀ i, Measurable (X i)) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P → (∀ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X i ω)) P) → ProbabilityTheory.mgf (∑ i ∈ s, X i) P t = ∏ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.mgf (X i) P t
